# Example MySQL schemas (ronaldbradford/schema)

Fixture SQL files are excerpts from [ronaldbradford/schema](https://github.com/ronaldbradford/schema) (Example MySQL Schemas from open-source projects).

Used by pytest to verify we can parse real-world MySQL DDL and generate synthetic data.

Source: `https://github.com/ronaldbradford/schema`  
Sakila: MySQL sample database (e.g. `sakila.sql`).
